description: Every version of one dataset row, newest first: when it was first seen, each change with the fields before and after (a price's history, say), and when it went or came back. Monity keeps a version only when the row changed, as long as the plan keeps checks (a year at most) and at most 1,000 versions a row. Long values are cut to 300 characters. Get the row's key from get_dataset_rows; page with before.

before.description: nextBefore from the previous answer, for older versions
